sections.content:
Rep.ai is building the next generation of live chat — powered by human-level AI avatars.
Tired of clunky, frustrating chatbot popups? So are we. Rep.ai reimagines online communication by replacing outdated bots with AI-powered video avatars that feel like talking to a real human — but available 24/7, infinitely scalable, and trained to convert. See it in action at rep.ai.

sections.heading: Job Description
sections.content:
We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our core team and help build the infrastructure behind AI Live Chat. You’ll work on systems that power real-time interactions, intelligent agent behaviors, and seamless integrations across the web — all at scale.
This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, loves clean code, and wants to help shape the future of AI-powered customer experience.

sections.heading: What You’ll Do
sections.content:
Build core systems using Python, Postgres, and AWS.
Design and maintain APIs that support real-time video chat and AI agent behavior.
Optimize performance and scalability, ensuring our AI avatars feel fast and natural.
Harden security, especially in cloud environments, and proactively mitigate vulnerabilities.
Write clean, testable code, and help maintain high engineering standards through code review and documentation.
Solve hard problems, debug complex issues, and help evolve our system architecture as we scale.

sections.heading: What We’re Looking For
sections.content:
8+ years of experience in software development with strong fluency in Python
Deep knowledge of Postgres and SQL
Production experience with AWS services
Familiarity with front-end technologies and frameworks (e.g., React)
Strong grasp of RESTful API design
Git proficiency and comfort with version control workflows
A track record of writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Experience in agile teams and working asynchronously
Bonus: leadership or mentoring experience

sections.heading: Why Join Us
sections.content:
Competitive compensation
Fully remote / async team
A chance to shape the future of how humans and AI interact online

If you’re an experienced engineer ready to build ambitious, intelligent systems with real-world impact — we’d love to hear from you.
👉 Check out what we’re building at rep.ai and apply now.
